title: Why Ellie let Abby go in The Last of Us Part II
subject: ellie
description:
Would you have let Abby go? 👇

Ellie's final choice in Santa Barbara and what it cost her. Spoilers for the ending of The Last of Us Part II.

tags: the last of us part 2 ending

scenes.text: For one more shot at Abby, Ellie left Dina and baby JJ.
She found Abby in Santa Barbara, tied to a post on the beach by a slaver gang called the Rattlers.
Ellie cut her down and made her fight in the shallows, and lost two fingers.
She remembered Joel on the porch, the night before he died, when she said she'd like to try to forgive him.
At the empty farmhouse, she picked up the guitar Joel taught her. Her hand couldn't make the chords.
She left the guitar there and walked out.
